result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall: the header, search bar, category chips, promo banner, carousels, and bottom navigation are aligned and legible. The only items I flagged are minor. The clipped chip and carousel items at the right edge and the card cut off at the bottom are intentional scroll affordances, so I did not report them.

issues.description: The circular button at the top right shows only a red notification dot with no icon or avatar, so it looks empty or like a failed image load.
issues.suggestion: Render a profile avatar or a bell/profile icon inside the circle, or confirm the avatar image loads and add a fallback placeholder.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card repeats delivery information: the '€0 delivery' badge on the image and '€0 delivery' again in the metadata line.
issues.suggestion: Show the free-delivery information once, either as the image badge or in the metadata line, to reduce redundancy.
